title: Marguerite and the Gravity
author: Beatrix Delacroix
blurb: Freya Dunmore, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
